author: Karl Rock
description:
I stopped at a petrol station while travelling through Northern Sindh and decided to have a look around. It seemed pretty basic at first, but there was a lot more going on than I expected.

There was a mosque, a bathroom, a shop selling everything from burgers and chocolates to gulab jamun and halwa, a fruit seller, and even a busy market behind the station selling vegetables, fish and tea.

You might be surprised by what we find inside a Pakistani petrol station!
title: What's inside a Pakistani gas station?
